rule_text: Do not conflate distinct issues when evaluating a requirement: treat a modal verb correction (e.g., 'shall be able to' → 'shall') as valid on its own merits without conflating it with separate note-quality or TBD problems that require independent attention.

Prefer the requirement wording that preserves the original logical sense of a bound (e.g., 'no less than', 'no more than') over a reworded alternative (e.g., 'within') that inverts or narrows the intended constraint.
